settings.q: How should I wash my kit?
settings.a: Cold wash, inside out, no fabric softener — it clogs the fibres that make performance fabric breathe. Hang dry where you can; low tumble if you must.

settings.q: What are your fabrics made from?
settings.a: Combed ring-spun cotton for the tees, a recycled poly-elastane knit for the training pieces. Full composition is listed on each product page.
